title: Blind-spot indicators and mirror visibility
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on blind-spot indicators in the mirrors and a few mentions of mirror-related blind spots, but many fragments use the word "spot" in unrelated ways or lack enough context for a clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise blind-spot indicators or warning lights in the mirrors as useful equipment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments include unclear mentions of mirror blind spots and several unrelated uses of the word "spot" that do not support a reliable sentiment reading.

limitations: Several sampled fragments are only loosely related to blind-spot or mirror features because they use the word "spot" in other contexts.
One positive fragment includes inconsistent blind-spot warning performance, but it is assigned positive and there are no mixed or negative examples to summarize separately.
Examples are limited, so the undetermined set does not provide enough context to clearly separate feature complaints from incidental wording in every case.
